<select id="selectContract" resultMap="ContractSource" resultOrdered="true">SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAY(o.company_code,o.contract_no) AS CHAR) AS raw_key,o.migration_issue AS issue,o.company_code AS `company_code`,o.contract_no AS `contract_no`,o.customer_code AS `customer_code`,o.customer_name AS `customer_name`,'DPPMS_ERP' AS `master_source_system`,CAST(JSON_ARRAY(o.company_code,o.contract_no) AS CHAR) AS `master_source_record_key`,rr.currency_name AS `currency_name`,rr.currency_name AS `currency_code`,rr.contract_amount AS `contract_amount`,rr.contract_create_time AS `contract_create_time`,COALESCE(ss.project_name,rr.project_name) AS `project_name`,rr.project_code AS `project_code`,COALESCE(ss.market_code,rr.market_code) AS `market_code`,COALESCE(ss.market_name,rr.market_name) AS `market_name`,COALESCE(ss.department_code,rr.department_code) AS `department_code`,rr.department_name AS `department_name`,rr.industry_code AS `industry_code`,rr.industry_name AS `industry_name`,rr.marketing_representative_code AS `marketing_representative_code`,rr.marketing_representative_name AS `marketing_representative_name`,rr.secondary_representative_code AS `secondary_representative_code`,ss.system_name AS `system_name` FROM (
    SELECT MIN(x.company_code) AS company_code, MIN(x.contract_no) AS contract_no,
      MIN(NULLIF(x.customer_code,'')) AS customer_code, MIN(NULLIF(x.customer_name,'')) AS customer_name,
      CASE WHEN MAX(x.customer_code_invalid)=1 THEN 'ERP_CUSTOMER_CODE_FORMAT_INVALID'
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(NULLIF(x.customer_code,'') AS BINARY))>1
          OR COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(NULLIF(x.customer_name,'') AS BINARY))>1 THEN 'CONTRACT_CUSTOMER_CONFLICT'
        ELSE NULL END AS migration_issue
    FROM (
      SELECT o.company_code,o.contract_no,o.customer_name,
        CASE WHEN o.customer_code IS NULL OR o.customer_code='' THEN o.customer_code
          WHEN o.customer_code REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]'
            AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(o.customer_code,2)))<=5
          THEN CONCAT(LEFT(o.customer_code,1),LPAD(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(o.customer_code,2)),5,'0'))
          ELSE NULL END AS customer_code,
        CASE WHEN o.customer_code IS NOT NULL AND o.customer_code<>''
          AND (NOT(o.customer_code REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]')
            OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(o.customer_code,2)))>5)
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS customer_code_invalid,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
          PARTITION BY CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY)
          ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.order_no IS NOT NULL AND o.order_no<>'' THEN CASE o.order_type WHEN '0' THEN 2 WHEN '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END DESC,
            CAST(CASE WHEN o.order_type IN ('0','1') AND o.order_no IS NOT NULL AND o.order_no<>'' THEN o.order_no END AS BINARY) DESC
        ) AS customer_order_rank
      FROM com_sales_order o
      WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.deleted=0
        AND o.source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS')
        AND o.company_code IS NOT NULL AND o.company_code<>''
        AND o.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND o.contract_no<>''
      
      
    ) x
    WHERE x.customer_order_rank=1
    GROUP BY CAST(x.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(x.contract_no AS BINARY)
    ORDER BY CAST(x.company_code AS BINARY),CAST(x.contract_no AS BINARY) 
  ) o LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.tenant_id,s.contract_no,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `project_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`department_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `department_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`system_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`system_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.source_record_key,64,' '),CAST(s.`system_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `system_name`
FROM com_shipment_contract_reference s
JOIN int_base_sync_binding own ON own.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND own.target_id=s.id AND own.object_key='SHIPMENT_CONTRACT' AND own.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_task task ON task.tenant_id=own.tenant_id AND task.id=own.task_id AND task.deleted=FALSE AND task.task_code='BASE_P15' AND task.connection_id=#{parameters.connectionId}
WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.deleted=b'0' AND s.source_system='DPPMS'
GROUP BY s.tenant_id,s.contract_no) ss ON ss.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND CAST(ss.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.tenant_id,s.contract_no,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`currency_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`currency_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`currency_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `currency_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`contract_amount` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`contract_amount` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`contract_amount` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `contract_amount`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`contract_create_time` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`contract_create_time` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`contract_create_time` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `contract_create_time`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `project_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`project_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `project_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`market_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `market_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`market_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`market_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `market_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`department_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`department_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `department_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`department_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`department_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`department_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `department_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`industry_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`industry_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`industry_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `industry_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`industry_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`industry_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`industry_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `industry_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketing_representative_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketing_representative_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`marketing_representative_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `marketing_representative_code`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketing_representative_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketing_representative_name` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`marketing_representative_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `marketing_representative_name`,
 SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`secondary_representative_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`secondary_representative_code` AS CHAR)<>''
  THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.source_sync_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(s.source_record_key,20,'0')),CAST(s.`secondary_representative_code` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `secondary_representative_code`
FROM com_contract_receivable s
JOIN int_base_sync_binding own ON own.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND own.target_id=s.id AND own.object_key='RECEIVABLE' AND own.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_task task ON task.tenant_id=own.tenant_id AND task.id=own.task_id AND task.deleted=FALSE AND task.task_code='BASE_P24' AND task.connection_id=#{parameters.connectionId}
WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.deleted=b'0'
GROUP BY s.tenant_id,s.contract_no) rr ON rr.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND CAST(rr.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectShipmentContract" resultMap="ShipmentContractSource" resultOrdered="true">
SELECT f.contract_id AS raw_key,f.warranty AS raw_warranty,'DPPMS' AS `source_system`,f.contract_id AS `source_record_key`,f.contract_code AS `contract_no`,f.office_code AS `department_code`,CAST(f.contract_type AS CHAR) AS `contract_type`,f.customer_name AS `customer_name`,f.project_name AS `project_name`,f.marketCode AS `market_code`,f.marketName AS `market_name`,CAST(f.systemId AS CHAR) AS `system_source_key`,f.systemName AS `system_name`,f.remark AS `remark` FROM fb_contract f WHERE NOT ((f.contract_id IS NULL OR TRIM(f.contract_id)='') AND (f.contract_code IS NULL OR TRIM(f.contract_code)='')) LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectPackage" resultMap="PackageSource" resultOrdered="true">
SELECT p.packlist_id AS raw_key,'DPPMS' AS `source_system`,p.packlist_id AS `source_record_key`,p.packlist_id AS `package_no`,p.packdate AS `shipment_time`,p.warrantyStartTime AS `warranty_start_time`,p.warrantyEndTime AS `warranty_end_time`,p.receiveName AS `receiver_name`,p.emsNum AS `express_no`,p.emsCompany AS `carrier_code`,p.con_id AS `shipment_contract_source_key` FROM fb_shipment p LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectShipmentEvent" resultMap="ShipmentEventSource" resultOrdered="true">
SELECT CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS raw_key,'DPPMS' AS `source_system`,CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS `source_key`,b.barcode AS `device_sn`,b.pack_id AS `package_no`,b.pack_id AS `legacy_package_key`,CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.rma_no,'')<>'' THEN 'UNCLASSIFIED' ELSE 'SHIPMENT' END AS `event_type`,CASE WHEN COALESCE(b.rma_no,'')<>'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS `rma_marked`,b.warrantyStartDate AS `warranty_start_date`,b.warrantyMonth AS `warranty_months`,b.rma_no AS `rma_no`,b.rmaBarcode AS `rma_related_sn`,b.updateTime AS `source_updated_at`,b.orderNumber AS `order_no`,CAST(b.lineNum AS CHAR) AS `line_no`,b.item AS `product_code`,b.barcode2 AS `secondary_sn`,b.item2 AS `secondary_item`,b.com_barcode AS `internal_serial_no`,b.isRMA AS `is_rma`,b.profitCenter AS `profit_center`,b.soleAgentSuffix AS `sole_agent_suffix`,b.syncTime AS `sync_time`,b.uuid AS `uuid` FROM fb_shipment_barcode b ORDER BY b.id LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectDeviceRelationship" resultMap="DeviceRelationshipSource" resultOrdered="true">
SELECT CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS raw_key,'DPPMS' AS `source_system`,CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS `source_key`,r.sn1 AS `source_device_sn`,r.sn2 AS `target_device_sn`,'EXTRA_SN' AS `relationship_type`,r.contract AS `contract_no`,r.createtime AS `raw_relationship_created_at`,r.updatetime AS `source_version`,r.item1 AS `source_item`,r.item2 AS `target_item` FROM fb_shipment_barcode_relation r WHERE r.sn1<>r.sn2 ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}</select>
<select id="countShipmentEvents" resultType="long">SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fb_shipment_barcode</select>

<select id="selectContractCustomers" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P15DeliverySyncTask$ContractCustomer">
SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAY(CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END,r.contractNo) AS CHAR) AS raw_key,
 CASE r.compCode WHEN '01' THEN '001' WHEN '02' THEN '002' WHEN '03' THEN '003' WHEN '04' THEN '004' ELSE r.compCode END AS company_code,r.contractNo AS contract_no,r.customerName AS customer_name,r.orderType AS order_type,r.orderNumber AS order_no,
 CASE WHEN r.customerCode IS NULL OR r.customerCode='' THEN r.customerCode
 WHEN r.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]' AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(r.customerCode,2)))<=5
 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(r.customerCode,1),LPAD(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(r.customerCode,2)),5,'0')) ELSE NULL END AS customer_code,
 CASE WHEN r.customerCode IS NOT NULL AND r.customerCode<>'' AND (NOT(r.customerCode REGEXP '^[A-Za-z]') OR CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(LEADING '0' FROM SUBSTRING(r.customerCode,2)))>5) THEN 'ERP_CUSTOMER_CODE_FORMAT_INVALID' ELSE NULL END AS issue
FROM pm_order_data_from_erp r WHERE r.source IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') AND r.compCode IS NOT NULL AND r.compCode<>'' AND r.contractNo IS NOT NULL AND r.contractNo<>''
ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
</select>

<select id="selectContractShipmentFields" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P15DeliverySyncTask$Row">
SELECT s.contract_code AS contract_no,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.contract_id,64,' '),CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `project_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketCode` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketCode` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.contract_id,64,' '),CAST(s.`marketCode` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_code`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketName` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketName` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.contract_id,64,' '),CAST(s.`marketName` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `market_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`office_code` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`office_code` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.contract_id,64,' '),CAST(s.`office_code` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `department_code`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`systemName` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`systemName` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(RPAD(s.contract_id,64,' '),CAST(s.`systemName` AS CHAR)) END),65) AS `system_name`
FROM fb_contract s WHERE NOT ((s.contract_id IS NULL OR TRIM(s.contract_id)='') AND (s.contract_code IS NULL OR TRIM(s.contract_code)='')) GROUP BY s.contract_code LIMIT #{limit}
</select>

<select id="selectContractReceivableFields" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P15DeliverySyncTask$Row">
SELECT s.contract_num AS contract_no,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`currency_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`currency_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`currency_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `currency_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`contract_money_amount` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`contract_money_amount` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`contract_money_amount` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `contract_amount`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`contract_create_date` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`contract_create_date` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`contract_create_date` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `contract_create_time`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`project_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`project_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `project_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`projectCode` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`projectCode` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`projectCode` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `project_code`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketCode` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketCode` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`marketCode` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `market_code`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`maketing_department_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`maketing_department_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`maketing_department_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `market_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`officeCode` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`officeCode` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`officeCode` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `department_code`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`office_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`office_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`office_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `department_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`industryId` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`industryId` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`industryId` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `industry_code`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`industry_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`industry_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`industry_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `industry_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`usernamec` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`usernamec` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`usernamec` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `marketing_representative_code`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`marketing_representative_name` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`marketing_representative_name` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`marketing_representative_name` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `marketing_representative_name`,
SUBSTRING(MAX(CASE WHEN s.`usernamec2` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.`usernamec2` AS CHAR)<>'' THEN CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(LEFT(CAST(s.update_time AS CHAR),19),'1000-01-01 00:00:00'),LPAD(CAST(s.id AS CHAR),20,'0')),CAST(s.`usernamec2` AS CHAR)) END),40) AS `secondary_representative_code`
FROM sms_ofst_contract_head_sap s WHERE s.contract_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.contract_num LIMIT #{limit}
</select>
